pairs.note: Matches the key on quarterly redemption timing, 65 days' notice, 20% quarter-end gate, 90% of proceeds within 30 days and the 10% holdback until the annual audit. However, it entirely omits the 3% early redemption fee on redemptions within 12 months of initial subscription (retained by the Fund, not applicable to Class E), which is a required substantive element of the key.
